comparison.objective: Install a rack rail; record stores a long board behind two leaning boards without removing them.
comparison.physical_skill: Mechanical latching, telescoping alignment, and fastening versus bimanual obstacle management and constrained sliding of a long board.
comparison.success_condition: Complete post engagement and correct screw-hole use versus final board position behind the existing boards without disturbing/removing them.
comparison.reason: Long-object handling is shared, but the defining manipulation and endpoint mechanics differ.
